// 1. Mapping nilai dari CBT: (kelas + "___" + mapel + "___" + no_ujian) -> nilai
const scoreMap = {};
const subjectsPerClass = {}; // kelas -> Set mapel

for (const row of allData) {
    const k = row.kelas || "Tanpa_Kelas";
    const m = row.mata_pelajaran || "Tanpa_Mapel";
    const nu = row.no_ujian || "";
    
    scoreMap[k + "___" + m + "___" + nu] = (row.nilai !== undefined) ? row.nilai : "";
    
    if (!subjectsPerClass[k]) {
        subjectsPerClass[k] = new Set();
    }
    subjectsPerClass[k].add(m);
}

// 2. Generate CSV per kelas dan per mapel berdasarkan MASTER ROSTER
const output = [];

for (const kelas of Object.keys(subjectsPerClass).sort()) {
    const roster = MASTER_ROSTER[kelas] || [];
    const subjects = Array.from(subjectsPerClass[kelas]).sort();
    
    for (const mapel of subjects) {
        let csvRows = [
            `"${kelas} - ${mapel}"`,
            "no,no_ujian,nama,nilai"
        ];
        
        roster.forEach((s, idx) => {
            const key = kelas + "___" + mapel + "___" + s.no_ujian;
            const nilai = (scoreMap[key] !== undefined) ? scoreMap[key] : "";
            
            const cleanNama = (s.nama || "").replace(/"/g, '""');
            const escapedNama = cleanNama.includes(",") ? `"${cleanNama}"` : cleanNama;
            
            csvRows.push([
                idx + 1,
                s.no_ujian,
                escapedNama,
                nilai
            ].join(","));
        });
        
        const cleanMapelFilename = mapel.replace(/[\\/:*?"<>| ]/g, "_");
        const fileName = `rekap_${kelas}_${cleanMapelFilename}.csv`;
        
        output.push({
            json: {
                kelas: kelas,
                mata_pelajaran: mapel,
                total_siswa: roster.length,
                fileName: fileName,
                csv: csvRows.join("\r\n")
            }
        });
    }
}

return output;
